description: The owner says the call is urgent: earliest possible, even outside their hours. Aria asks calendar_find_times with owner_hours any and books the earliest slot it returns, even though it is outside the owner's working hours, and says so. Settings are soft signals; the owner's words win.

trigger.owner_ask: I need 30 minutes with Priya (priya@partner.example.com) as soon as possible, tonight is fine, even outside my hours.
